issues.issue: Was the IAD's best interests of the child assessment, and so its refusal of H&C relief, reasonable?
issues.applicant_position: IAD ignored central evidence on son relationship, misapprehended it, and gave no reasons for any credibility finding.
issues.respondent_position: IAD assessment reasonable given scant evidence; applicant asks court to reweigh the evidence.
issues.result_quote: I find that the IAD reasonably assessed the BIOC in the Applicant’s case
